searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords or phrases to search Bluesky posts for. Supports quoted phrases, from:handle, and hashtags.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Bluesky handles to scrape posts from (e.g. bsky.app or user.bsky.social). '@' prefix is optional.

maxPosts.title: Max posts per query/profile
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to fetch for each search query or profile.

sortBy.title: Sort search results by
sortBy.description: How to sort keyword search results. Ignored for profiles (always newest first).

sinceDate.title: Only posts after (YYYY-MM-DD)
sinceDate.description: Optional. Only include posts created on or after this date.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Include reply posts when scraping profiles.

blueskyIdentifier.title: Bluesky handle or email (required for search)
blueskyIdentifier.description: Your Bluesky handle (e.g. yourname.bsky.social) or email. Required for keyword search. Profile scraping works without it.

blueskyAppPassword.title: Bluesky app password (required for search)
blueskyAppPassword.description: An app password from Bluesky Settings → Privacy and Security → App Passwords. Never use your main account password.
